rationale: Identity verification was done correctly using full name + zip, matching a single user. However, the agent performed order-changing writes (cancelling two pending orders and initiating a return) without first explicitly stating the exact changes and obtaining the user’s confirmation to proceed, as required by policy. The user confirmed the item and refund method for the return but was never asked to explicitly confirm cancellation of orders #W5199551 and #W8665881 after the agent listed them. Additionally, the agent provided specific refund totals for the canceled orders that were not supported by any tool outputs (no totals were returned and item lists were truncated), and asserted that all refunds (including cancellations) would go to PayPal despite the cancel tool not specifying a refund method. The agent also stated processing timelines and email notifications without tool confirmation. These issues violate the requirements to avoid unsupported or fabricated information and to confirm before writes, so the conversation fails the pass bar.
